Description.name: Bbdek$tr
Description.description: The bbdek$tr and its chiral counterpart are two-of-a-kind. Wherever one goes, you can be sure that the other is not far behind. So close are these bros that they've been compared to two peas in a pod... specifically, the pods of an Edamimi? Fortunately, the Monster World is equally accessible to left-handed and right-handed beings, Largely because it has to be accessible for beings without any hands at all! As a righty, the bbdek$tr shows moderately increased aptitudes for linguistics and fine motor skills.
